ant_prompt.objective: Analyze the QuantFlow trading system AFTER the recent win-rate improvement implementation (profit_target_exit, min_conditions, trailing stops, RSI-adaptive targets, strength-weighted consolidation, per-strategy risk budgets, per-strategy Kelly sizing) to find REMAINING bottlenecks limiting win rate from reaching 65%+. Focus on: calibration gaps (are default parameter values optimal?), edge cases (does profit_target_exit handle all scenarios?), interaction effects (do new features conflict with each other?), and missing mechanisms (what's still NOT implemented that top quantitative systems use?).
evidence_requirements: At least 1 file:line reference per node visited — quote actual code
Specific parameter value with current default vs suggested range
Concrete code snippet showing the bottleneck or gap
Cross-reference between modules when finding interaction effects
ant_prompt.tools_hint: Use Read + Grep for code-based exploration. Focus on quantflow/strategy/templates/, quantflow/signal/, quantflow/strategy/research/, quantflow/strategy/validation/
